senses.gloss: m.(b. h. רֹבֶה, Gen. XXI, 20; רָבָה) [growing,] young man, youth.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 26a:3">Sot. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>הר׳ שנשא עקרה וכ׳</he> a young man who married a barren or an old woman. Y. ib. VIII, 22ᵈ bot. <he>ר׳ שנשא ריבה</he> a young man that married a young girl; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="T00306"><he>רוֹבִים</he></cite>, <he>רוֹבִין</he>.
Tam. I, 1 והר׳ שומרים שם the young priests held watch there; [anoth. opinion: the archers, v. רְבֵי II].—Esp. הר׳ the sons of R. Ḥiyya.
<cite ref="Chullin 20a:2">Ḥull. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>יקבלו הר׳ וכ׳</he> let the lads receive the answer to their arguments.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:4:2">Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᶜ</cite> bot.; a. e.
